# MudBlazor

> MudBlazor is a Blazor component library based on Material Design, written in C# with almost no JavaScript. It targets .NET 8, 9, and 10, and runs in Blazor Server, Blazor WebAssembly, and Blazor Hybrid apps.

The documentation site is a Blazor WebAssembly app, but it prerenders full HTML for recognized crawlers, so the pages below can be fetched and read directly. Component pages show runnable examples with their source; every documented type also has a generated API page listing its parameters, events, and methods.

## Getting started

- [Installation](https://mudblazor.com/getting-started/installation): Add MudBlazor to a Blazor Server, WebAssembly, or Hybrid project.
- [Usage](https://mudblazor.com/getting-started/usage): The providers, imports, and minimal layout a MudBlazor app needs before anything renders.
- [Layouts](https://mudblazor.com/getting-started/layouts): Compose an app shell from MudLayout, MudAppBar, MudDrawer, and MudMainContent.
- [Wireframes](https://mudblazor.com/getting-started/wireframes): Copy-paste starting points for common page shapes.

## Components

- [API index](https://mudblazor.com/api): Generated reference for every documented type — the complete component listing. Start here to find a component not named below.
- [Button](https://mudblazor.com/components/button): Filled, outlined, and text buttons, icons, and loading state.
- [Text Field](https://mudblazor.com/components/textfield): The base text input, including validation, adornments, and masking.
- [Select](https://mudblazor.com/components/select): Single and multi-select dropdown bound to a value or a collection.
- [Autocomplete](https://mudblazor.com/components/autocomplete): Async search-as-you-type input backed by a user-supplied search function.
- [Form](https://mudblazor.com/components/form): MudForm and EditForm validation, including FluentValidation.
- [Data Grid](https://mudblazor.com/components/datagrid): Sorting, filtering, grouping, virtualization, editing, and server-side data.
- [Table](https://mudblazor.com/components/table): The simpler tabular component, with client- and server-side paging.
- [Dialog](https://mudblazor.com/components/dialog): Modal dialogs shown through IDialogService, with results and custom content.
- [Snackbar](https://mudblazor.com/components/snackbar): Transient notifications shown through ISnackbar.
- [Charts](https://mudblazor.com/components/charts): Bar, stacked-bar, line, pie, donut, heatmap, radar, rose, sankey, scatter, and time-series charts.

## Features

- [Icons](https://mudblazor.com/features/icons): The bundled Material icon set and how to supply custom SVG icons.
- [Colors](https://mudblazor.com/features/colors): The Color enum and the Material palette behind it.
- [Breakpoints](https://mudblazor.com/features/breakpoints): Responsive breakpoints, the MudHidden component, and the IBrowserViewportService API.
- [Parameter State](https://mudblazor.com/features/parameterstate): The ParameterState framework every component uses for parameter change handling.
- [Localization](https://mudblazor.com/features/localization): Translating built-in component strings.
- [RTL Languages](https://mudblazor.com/features/rtl-languages): Right-to-left layout support.
- [Analyzers](https://mudblazor.com/features/analyzers): The MudBlazor Roslyn analyzers and what they catch.
- [Services](https://mudblazor.com/features/services): The injectable services MudBlazor registers.

## Customization

- [Overview](https://mudblazor.com/customization/overview): How MudTheme, palettes, typography, and CSS variables fit together.
- [Palette](https://mudblazor.com/customization/palette): Define light and dark palettes.
- [Typography](https://mudblazor.com/customization/typography): Override the type scale.
- [Default theme](https://mudblazor.com/customization/default-theme): Every value the default MudTheme ships with.
- [Globals](https://mudblazor.com/customization/globals): MudGlobal defaults that change component behavior application-wide.

## CSS utilities

- [Spacing](https://mudblazor.com/utilities/spacing): Margin and padding utility classes.
- [Display](https://mudblazor.com/utilities/display): Display and responsive-visibility utilities.
- [Flex](https://mudblazor.com/utilities/flex): Flexbox utilities — direction, wrap, grow, shrink, and alignment.
- [Border Radius](https://mudblazor.com/utilities/border-radius): Corner-rounding utilities.
